title: 17925 - 17925/P1517
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Power Supply Relay for Engine Control Module (J271 or J363) faulty
Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri between Engine Control Module (J220) and Power Supply Relay for Engine Control Module (J271 or J363) faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin: /Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Power Supply Relay for Engine Control Module (J271 or J363)
Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri between Engine Control Module (J220) and Power Supply Relay for Engine Control Module (J271 or J363)
Kontrol edin: /Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Engine Control Module (J220)
technicalNotes: When found in Tdi engines in combination with P2146/008518 - Supply Voltage for Fuel Injector Group A: Open Circuit  - 009 - Open or Short to Ground check the injectors and their wiring as noted Here
